body: Even with -video none, MAME came to the front on macOS. Automated runs set SDL_MAC_BACKGROUND_APP=1; the MAME started by hand (pid 94103) had exited by 15:18.
fix: SDL_MAC_BACKGROUND_APP=1 on every MAME run, through one xtask helper with a source-scan test
summary: MAME windows took the owner's focus during automated runs
